findings.title: DEBUG=True in Development Configuration
findings.impact: Information disclosure (tracebacks, environment paths, internal variables) if development settings are deployed to production environments.
findings.evidence: DEBUG = True is set in config/settings/development.py. In production.py, DEBUG is driven by environment variable DJANGO_DEBUG with fallback to False.
findings.remediation: Enforce that production deployments strictly use config.settings.production with DJANGO_DEBUG=False and secure secret key injection.

findings.title: Default Hardcoded Secret Key in Local Settings
findings.impact: Weak session signing and CSRF tokens if SECRET_KEY environment variable is not supplied in production.
findings.evidence: base.py contains a fallback default SECRET_KEY if not found in environment.
findings.remediation: In production.py, raise ImproperlyConfigured if SECRET_KEY is not explicitly set in the environment.

findings.title: In-Memory Cache Rate Limiting Scalability in Multi-Worker Setups
findings.impact: LocMemCache is per-process; across multiple Gunicorn/Uvicorn worker processes, an IP address could send up to (workers * limit) requests per minute.
findings.evidence: Throttling uses django.core.cache.cache which defaults to LocMemCache in development.
findings.remediation: Deploy Redis cache (django-redis) in production environment for distributed rate-limiting state synchronization.

findings.title: Strict Model Deserialization using XGBoost Native JSON
findings.impact: Zero arbitrary code execution vulnerability from model loading.
findings.evidence: Models are loaded exclusively via xgboost.Booster.load_model() from native JSON files rather than pickle / joblib serialization.
findings.remediation: Maintain native JSON model loading; prevent any regression to pickle or joblib.

findings.title: Bounded Exogenous Input Validation & Strict Error Masking
findings.impact: Protection against NaN, Infinity, and extreme out-of-distribution numerical attacks; no internal filesystem paths or stack traces leaked to clients.
findings.evidence: InputContractsBoundaryTests (16 tests) confirmed 100% rejection with HTTP 400 and clean JSON error payloads.
findings.remediation: Keep strict schema contracts and Pydantic/dataclass boundaries intact.
